newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells $43 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells $43 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 2.375 billion shillings ($43 million) of treasury bills at its weekly auction, bank officials said on Thursday.
In the main 91-day category of bills, the bank sold 2.218 billion shillings at an average yield of 18.961 percent compared to 4.748 billion shillings at an average yield of 19.246 percent last week.
In the 182-day category, the bank sold 157 million shillings at 19.752 percent from 19.874 percent. Last week the bank sold 207 million shillings of 182-day t-bills.
The bank said the reduction in the number of bids for treasury bills was due to a shift for the floating-rate treasury bond offered by the bank which is pegged to the 91-day t-bill.
